versions.changelog: v1.0.0: hands-on playbook for AI model and asset lifecycle management (LLMOps) - five asset types inventory (models, prompts, knowledge bases, evaluation sets, agent configs), Model Card and registration, version management with canary release and one-click rollback, launch approval and retirement, drift monitoring (data/concept/model drift with alert thresholds), cost governance (token accounting, budgets, routing tiers, distillation and caching), governance processes (roles, approval flows, audit); 5-command zero-dependency toolkit
